decision: Refine atmosphere and composition before new mechanics
why: Existing room and island art is constrained by dark blank space and narrow card layout
result: Planned; whole-game goal remains active

decision: Use shared day, dusk and rain colours across the room, Focus mode and island controls
why: Make ambience feel coherent without another renderer or extra motion
result: Theme checks pass

decision: Remove CSS cloud blobs and keep subtle light and mist
why: The first live preview showed distracting clipped shapes beside the room
result: Discarded the cloud prototype

decision: Stretch the house page across its flex parent on tablets
why: The first screenshot exposed blank space despite the canvas-to-page check passing
result: Fixed and added a page-to-workspace width assertion

decision: Add the new atmosphere flow to CI
why: The unit suite caught its omission from the required flow matrix
result: 246 unit tests and 145 browser checks pass; build and guard pass

decision: Keep the atmosphere and responsive island layout
why: Desktop, tablet, phone and in-app images support the calmer presentation; performance stayed within normal variance
result: Two rounds versus main: GPU 1.35 ms both, p95 frame gap 16.7 ms both, zero slow gaps; idle 38.4 to 45.3 ms/s

decision: Regenerate the cliff from a rounder shore with smooth shading and a simpler colour profile
why: The previous pointed bands competed with the soft miniature; a shared outline keeps the lawn and cliff together
result: Foundations, stream exits and walking routes pass

decision: Add bounced light from below and retain a visible rounded underside
why: The first smooth cliff rendered nearly black; changing shape alone did not solve its lighting
result: Revised and inspected in daylight, dusk and the in-app browser

decision: Keep the sculpted island
why: 247 unit tests and 99 browser checks pass; GPU performance and draw calls remain stable
result: Two rounds: idle 54.9 to 55.1 ms/s, GPU 1.55 to 1.50 ms, 36 draw calls both, zero slow frames

decision: Keep the timer, duration and Start visible; disclose settings and progress
why: The user found the growing dashboard distracting
result: Desktop and phone screenshots inspected

decision: Remove Little moments and the header strip; keep direct room taps and quieter utilities
why: Room interactions should be subtle and the header should share the scenery
result: A real furniture tap starts the companion activity; 30 room and focus checks pass

decision: Use one compact Start/Pause bar when the original Start control is off screen
why: The miniature should remain visible without making study controls hard to reach
result: Eight browser tests pass, including four viewport sizes and keyboard return focus

decision: Derive coins, captured pet hearts and plant growth from the existing session; put previews inside Your progress
why: Keep the existing personal incentives without clutter or automatic purchases
result: 252 units and 23 production browser journeys pass; plant rewards have their own readable row

decision: Darken reward text after the initial contrast failure
why: The first preview did not meet the contrast check
result: Axe checks pass after the fix

decision: Compare the room with main before committing
why: Measure the effect of the full branch as well as the current UI phase
result: Two rounds: idle 114.9 to 110.0 ms/s, GPU 2.35 to 2.30 ms, p95 16.8 ms both, 148 draws both, zero slow frames; startup 691.1 to 967.2 ms

decision: Keep the simplified main room
why: The production suite, four viewport checks, real input and inspected images pass
result: Against the preceding checkpoint: startup 785.2 to 659.9 ms, idle 102.7 to 106.0 ms/s within variance, GPU 2.50 to 2.20 ms, 148 draws both, zero slow frames; the earlier startup difference did not persist

decision: Keep one compact bait and Cast dock; disclose tackle and catch chances
why: The full tackle shelf and idle captions obscured the pond
result: Desktop, phone and live in-app views inspected; actual catch and saved journal preserved

decision: Darken bait selection labels after contrast failure
why: The first selector measured 4.36:1 and failed Axe
result: Three dev and three production tests now pass, including arrow keys, Escape and empty bait

decision: Keep the calmer pond controls
why: Behavior and production verification passed
result: 20 real-input pond checks pass; 252 units and build pass; guard and diff review clean

decision: Render six original room presets with lh art and share those previews across room picking and design cards
why: The flat SVG diagrams failed to convey the game's furnished rooms
result: All six transparent WebP renders visually inspected; no extra live engines in the product

decision: Replace oversized arches with a compact vertical list and native opening/closing transitions
why: One room left too much empty space; the list must remain usable on phones
result: Nine browser tests pass, including image decoding, Axe, rapid reopen and reduced motion

decision: Room selection walks the avatar to its door; arrows retain quick travel
why: Preserve the user's requested physical journey while keeping a fast route available
result: Four old quick-travel expectations failed and were updated; all 80 relevant checks pass across the corrected rooms run and the picker/doors run; 252 units, build and guard pass

decision: Open on the scenery and reveal room details only after selection
why: The permanent side card and duplicate destination cards competed with the miniature
result: Desktop, tablet and phone views inspected; compact Rooms/Garden/Pond dock retains all routes

decision: Disclose room naming and the six design previews; keep coin cost and build action clear
why: Planning should preserve the island and avoid unnecessary copy
result: Four browser journeys pass with Axe, free previews, one-time spending, saved naming and keyboard return; fixed a shrinking mobile card found in screenshots

decision: Keep the island redesign and a single short detail-card entrance
why: 79 real-GPU house, atmosphere and travel checks passed
result: 252 units, build and guard pass; p95 16.8 to 16.7 ms, zero slow frames, 36 draw calls unchanged; GPU 1.35 to 1.60 ms with the larger canvas, idle 48.7 to 54.1 ms/s

decision: Replace the Plants/Seeds bar with direct bed markers and one compact seed or growth card
why: The user wanted interaction inside the garden and less management UI
result: 13 garden and transition journeys pass, plus the phone height and edge-tap regressions; 44 real-GPU checks pass

decision: Replace the miniature cottage with a flower-covered gate leading back to the island
why: The garden should connect to the island rather than jump straight into a room
result: Avatar, pet, all six beds, study targets, coin spending, names, collection and postcard export remain covered

decision: Keep marker hit areas fixed and animate their inner art
why: Real pointer tests found active CSS repositioning and WAAPI scaling could drop edge taps
result: Fixed both causes, added edge-tap checks, and waited for actual panel settlement in the 3D bed flow; 252 units, build and guard pass

decision: Replace overlapping thin platforms with one rounded bank, inset stones and trailing foliage
why: The user requested more depth while preserving the simple garden layout
result: The first underside was too dark; refined its profile and colors, removed unnecessary mounds and pulled border flowers onto supported ground; reviewed desktop, phone and rotated views

decision: Keep terrain batched with existing garden geometry and include its depth in camera framing
why: More depth must preserve all six reachable beds and smooth rendering
result: 44 GPU checks pass; 253 units, build and guard pass; 11 draw calls unchanged, zero slow frames, p95 16.7 to 16.8 ms and GPU 1.75 to 1.65 ms across two rounds; a later art-only refinement removed two mounds
